steps.stage: This is the card currently on the block.
steps.clock: The server's clock ends the lot. A late bid extends it.
steps.bid: Place your bid here. A bid is binding.
steps.rail: All lots in this auction, with price and status.
steps.sellSteps: Selling takes three steps: pick your cards, set the price, choose the time.
steps.sellStep: Each step asks for little. What you rarely need sits under Advanced options.
steps.sellPublish: Move between the steps here. Nothing is public until you publish on the last step.
steps.help: You can replay this tour any time under Help.

nextStep.label: Your next step
nextStep.notVerified: Confirm that the wallet is yours (free).
nextStep.noPaddle: Start bidding: one more signature, no payment.
nextStep.ready: Place a bid on the current lot.
nextStep.leading: You are leading. If nobody outbids you, the lot is yours.
nextStep.outbid: You were outbid. Bid again or wait for the next lot.
nextStep.won: You won. Pay now, the deadline is running.
nextStep.paying: Confirm in your wallet. Then the card is yours.
nextStep.waitingSeller: We are waiting for the seller's signature.
nextStep.confirming: Payment sent. We are waiting for the confirmation.
nextStep.done: Done. The card is in your wallet.
nextStep.showEnded: This show has ended. See all lots in the list.
nextStep.notOpen: The room is not open yet. You are ready.

hint.title: What your wallet shows next
hint.caveat: Your wallet may show its own notes.
hint.why: Why does my wallet ask this?
hint.signin: Your wallet will ask for a free confirmation next, and it moves no money.
hint.paddle: One more free confirmation, with no payment, so your bidding number can bid up to your limit without a wallet window for each bid.
hint.pay: Your wallet shows how much USDC you send, so check the amount before you confirm.
hint.consign: No confirmation is needed here, we only check that the card is in your wallet.
hint.credits: A payment of 1 USDC to Hammerprice for 10 AI drafts.
